name: Frahun Shadewhisper
summary: At Aldrassil in Shadowglen, Frahun Shadewhisper trains night elf rogues. He teaches new scouts and rogues stealth, agility, and covert strikes. Erion Shadewhisper, another rogue trainer in Darnassus, shares his family name.

sections.title: A Mentor in the Shadows
sections.body: At Aldrassil in Teldrassil, Frahun Shadewhisper teaches new rogues concealment and bladecraft. Night elf society honors priests, sentinels, and druids, yet scouts and infiltrators also help safeguard the World Tree's boughs. Recruits bring Frahun an encrypted sigil. He weighs their potential and guides their first steps in the craft.

faq.answer: Frahun Shadewhisper trains night elf rogues at Aldrassil in Teldrassil. He teaches new rogues stealth, precise combat, and covert tactics.

faq.q: Where can Frahun Shadewhisper be found?
faq.answer: Frahun Shadewhisper can be found in Aldrassil, Shadowglen's central stronghold on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Is Frahun related to Erion Shadewhisper?
faq.answer: Frahun Shadewhisper is believed to be kin to Erion Shadewhisper, who trains rogues in Darnassus. Their shared surname and work training rogues support that belief.

faq.q: What role does the Encrypted Sigil play with him?
faq.answer: New night elf rogues carry an encrypted sigil to Frahun Shadewhisper. It marks them as ready for formal instruction in the rogue's craft.

angles.text: As a rogue, Frahun Shadewhisper gives you your first lessons in stealth, ambush tactics, and weapon finesse.
As a night elf, you see how your people's nocturnal affinity and elusiveness become practical combat skills for protecting Teldrassil.
